faq.q: How much does The Kugel Law Firm charge?
faq.a: The Kugel Law Firm publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does The Kugel Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. The Kugel Law Firm publishes a free initial consultation. It publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does The Kugel Law Firm have offices?
faq.a: The Kugel Law Firm publishes two offices, in Newark and Manhattan. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at The Kugel Law Firm?
faq.a: The Kugel Law Firm names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

json_ld_descriptions: The Kugel Law Firm provides defense representation in DWI/DUI matters across New York and New Jersey. Upon contact, the firm offers a no-cost DWI/DUI Defense Strategy Session to identify potential strategies relevant to your case and help you understand the legal process ahead. The firm handles various aspects of DWI/DUI defense including refusal hearings, administrative hearings, car seizures, and appeals. Rachel, the lawyer and founder, is a criminal defense attorney who has defended hundreds of people on driving under the influence charges and appears regularly as a media expert on CNN, FOX News, CourtTV, MSNBC, and HLN. The firm aims to answer all your questions during the initial consultation and provide clarity on your case's action plan.
